D021_l001.question: A 31-year-old married female, who works as a wedding planner, presents with a several-month history of significant dietary restriction. The patient reports consuming an extremely limited daily caloric intake. She expresses a persistent desire for further weight loss and declines interventions aimed at weight restoration, despite her current underweight status. There is a noted preoccupation with body weight, characterized by compulsive self-weighing and intense anxiety regarding any perceived weight gain. The patient exhibits a distorted perception of her body, describing herself as larger than clinical observation indicates, particularly concerning specific body parts. She tends to minimize or dismiss concerns voiced by her physicians and family members regarding her health status.

    B. Acute Stress Disorder
    C. Bipolar II Disorder
    D. Bulimia Nervosa
